name: haina-travel
description: Sequence booked flights-hotels and drafts into a coherent day plan, catch conflicts early, and replan minimally.

displayDescription.zh: 为已订机酒或已有攻略的旅行排顺吃住玩日程，提前查出错漏冲突，变更时只动必要部分。
displayDescription.en: Turns booked trips and drafts into coherent daily plans, catches conflicts early, and replans only what is affected.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我的机酒已订，帮我把它排成一份顺路的每日计划。
defaultInitPrompt.en: My flights and hotel are booked; help me sequence a daily plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 我的机酒已订，帮我把它排成一份顺路的每日计划。
quickPrompts.en: My flights and hotel are booked; help me sequence a daily plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 这是我现有的行程安排，帮我查一下有没有走不通的地方。
quickPrompts.en: Here is my current itinerary; check it for conflicts and gaps.

quickPrompts.zh: 计划有变化，只调整受影响的部分，别动我已订的项目。
quickPrompts.en: Plans changed; adjust only what is affected and keep my bookings.
